schemas.name: gmdl-material-info
structure: ID 0x20D texture-set block or fixed-size ShaderData block
schemas.current_behavior: Unknown shader IDs are hard errors; 0x20D references are retained only as instance/group pairs; all other payloads are skipped by size.

schemas.name: gmdl-animation-trailer
known_framing: per animData: two 64-byte transforms, one u32 field, one 12-byte ResourceKey
per baked group: count u32 entries
schemas.terminal_key: three u32 words, named unknownKey by OpenSpore
families: CellImages/mini.gmdl family: known framing reaches the record end
real cell-stage groups 0x40616201/02: larger opaque baked-deform framing overran the known walk
schemas.current_behavior: The C++ walker attempts known framing, ignores failed trailer reads, reads up to three unknownKey words if possible, and always sets consumed to the input size.

schemas.name: rw4-container-header
schemas.current_behavior: Magic, ftype, manifest typecode, SectionTypes typecode, typecode-table bounds, section-table bounds, nonnegative sizes, and adjusted data bounds are checked.

schemas.name: rw4-section-info
schemas.adjusted_data: For tc 0x10030 BaseResource only, data equals pData plus pBufferData; other sections use pData as stored.
schemas.runtime_layout_match: Ghidra RWSectionInfo is also 24 bytes with data pointer, size, alignment, type-code index, and type code.
schemas.current_limitations: The C++ parser does not validate tcIndex against nTypes, does not require tc to equal typecodes[tcIndex], and does not validate the semantic identity of every section payload.

schemas.name: rw4-section-type-code-map

contradictions.claim_a: Gmdl.hpp says the parser rejects any truncated or undocumented content on the walk.
contradictions.claim_b: Gmdl.cpp makes trailer reads best-effort and returns true after setting consumed to size even when the known trailer framing fails.
contradictions.resolution: Treat renderable prefix and material-info as strict; treat the GMDL trailer as opaque/best-effort until a byte-exact variant decoder exists.

contradictions.claim_a: ASSET-PATH says GMDL parsing fails unless the final offset equals the record size and reports consumed equals file size.
contradictions.claim_b: The C++ parser does not expose or compare the Reader offset to size after the trailer and unconditionally sets consumed=size on success.
contradictions.resolution: The documentation is accurate for the Python oracle/mini fixture path but stronger than current C++ behavior.

contradictions.claim_a: The synthetic GMDL truncation test says a truncated record is rejected.
contradictions.claim_b: The test cuts at byte 48, which is inside geometry, so it validates the strict prefix but does not test trailer-only truncation.
contradictions.resolution: Do not generalize the test to trailer completeness; add separate trailer-offset assertions before claiming strict end coverage.

contradictions.claim_a: Rw4.hpp describes complete() as proving every section type code is well-formed/known.
contradictions.claim_b: Rw4::complete checks section count, nonnegative size, and adjusted data bounds; unknown type codes are explicitly informational.
contradictions.resolution: Use the implementation as source of truth: unknown type codes are accepted, not rejected.

contradictions.claim_a: rw4_test comments describe a known-type-code check.
contradictions.claim_b: rw4_test checks ftype, manifest walk, and in-bounds data, but does not call knownRw4TypeCode or reject unknown tc values.
contradictions.resolution: Treat the test as structural-boundary coverage, not complete semantic type-code coverage.

contradictions.claim_a: docs/RENDERWARE-RESEARCH.md maps section codes 0x20004/05 to VertexDescription/VertexBuffer and 0x20007/08/09 to IndexBuffer/TextureOverride/Mesh.
contradictions.claim_b: tools/spore/rw4/rw4.py uses an older or different map with 0x20001/02/04/05 and 0x40001/50001 for other objects.
contradictions.resolution: Do not merge the Python TYPES dictionary with the C++ known set or the committed SMFX map without a code-by-code payload census.

contradictions.claim_a: The Python GMDL oracle documents version up to 9 and conditionally changes material-info framing at v9.
contradictions.claim_b: The current C++ parser rejects every version other than 8.
contradictions.resolution: Record v9 as oracle/documentation evidence, not as a supported C++ behavior.

contradictions.claim_a: Early campaign notes initially described 0x0F43029A as possibly CellSerializer-based.
contradictions.claim_b: The resolved campaign finding and current source describe it as a separate model/part-definition format with part names and no derived loader reference.
contradictions.resolution: Use the resolved classification; do not treat the old hypothesis as current semantics.

contradictions.claim_a: GmdlModel.consumed is documented as input bytes consumed and equal to input size on a full parse.
contradictions.claim_b: The implementation sets consumed=size after the best-effort trailer, so the field is currently a success marker rather than a trustworthy cursor position.
contradictions.resolution: Add a separate validated offset field or trailer state before using consumed as a serialization integrity proof.
